# Filter the data for white males and females
white_males = df[(df['race'] == 'white') & (df['sex'] == 'male')]
white_females = df[(df['race'] == 'white') & (df['sex'] == 'female')]

# Check for missing values in the composite wealth columns
missing_1990 = white_males['composite_wealth_1990'].isnull().sum()
missing_1996 = white_males['composite_wealth_1996'].isnull().sum()

missing_1990_females = white_females['composite_wealth_1990'].isnull().sum()
missing_1996_females = white_females['composite_wealth_1996'].isnull().sum()

missing_1990, missing_1996, missing_1990_females, missing_1996_females

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Calculate coefficient of variation (CV) for white males
cv_1990_males = np.std(white_males['composite_wealth_1990']) / np.mean(white_males['composite_wealth_1990'])
cv_1996_males = np.std(white_males['composite_wealth_1996']) / np.mean(white_males['composite_wealth_1996'])

# Calculate coefficient of variation (CV) for white females
cv_1990_females = np.std(white_females['composite_wealth_1990']) / np.mean(white_females['composite_wealth_1990'])
cv_1996_females = np.std(white_females['composite_wealth_1996']) / np.mean(white_females['composite_wealth_1996'])

# Perform t-tests to check for statistical significance
t_stat_males, p_val_males = ttest_ind(white_males['composite_wealth_1990'], white_males['composite_wealth_1996'])
t_stat_females, p_val_females = ttest_ind(white_females['composite_wealth_1990'], white_females['composite_wealth_1996'])
